scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix database && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:prepare:dev: npm run prisma:generate:dev --prefix database && npm run db:migrate:deploy:dev
scripts.db:prepare:pro: npm run prisma:generate:pro --prefix database && npm run db:migrate:deploy:pro
scripts.start:dev: npm run db:prepare:dev && concurrently -n api,client "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.start:pro: npm run db:prepare:pro && npm run build --prefix client && npm run start:pro --prefix api
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix api && npm run test:ci --prefix client
